items.label: Waterproof & Lightweight
items.value: These men's hiking shoes feature a high-quality waterproof membrane to keep water out, while the ultra-lightweight construction (13oz) reduces foot fatigue and burden

items.label: Flexible & Comfortable
items.value: The removable insole provides stable support, and the flexible EVA midsole offers superior cushioning and high energy return, reducing foot fatigue and absorbing impact

items.label: Protective & Durable
items.value: The closed-cell tongue prevents debris, rain, and sand from entering. The abrasion-resistant suede upper and rubber toe cap provide complete protection and all-day comfort

items.label: Slip-Resistant & Versatile
items.value: The advanced multi-directional traction rubber outsole ensures stable and reliable grip in various environments. Designed for both daily wear and outdoor activities such as hiking, walking, hunting, camping, jungle, cycling, fishing, mountaineering, trekking, and travel

items.label: Brand Commitment
items.value: With over 21 years of design experience, OL OUTJET LEGEND is dedicated to pursuing the ultimate user experience—delivering exceptional comfort, support, and durability. A must-have for any outdoor enthusiast, we highly value your feedback. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us anytime

items.label: Special Features
items.value: All Weather Grip, Flexible, Lightweight, Slip Resistant, Waterproof

items.label: Fur Description
